stem: Let $X=\{2, -1\}$ and $Y=\{4, 0\}$. Build $X\times Y$ by tapping every ordered pair it contains.
solution: $X\times Y$ is the set of all ordered pairs $(x, y)$ with $x\in X$ and $y\in Y$: the first element comes from X, the second from Y.
Pair 2 with each element of Y: $(2, 4)$, $(2, 0)$.
Pair $-1$ with each element of Y: $(-1, 4)$, $(-1, 0)$.
notes: missing-pairs (an incomplete product) has no misconception in this objective's own list, so it is left unmapped. Wrong pairs from Y x X are exactly what reversed-pairs reports.
